name: paraguay-cross-border
description: Paraguay cross-border income tax for 2026: the non-resident income tax (Impuesto a la Renta de No Residentes, INR) under Ley N° 6380/2019 Título IV and Decreto N° 3181/2019, and the dividend tax (IDU) on profits paid to non-residents. Covers who is resident (companies under art. 5, individuals with permanent residence under Decreto 3181 art. 2), what Paraguayan-source income a non-resident is taxed on (art. 73), the 15% INR rate on the presumed net income of art. 75 (30%, 50%, 70% or 100% of the gross, so 4.5%, 7.5%, 10.5% or 15% of the payment), the withholding agents, the gross-up rule, digital services, sales of real estate and of Paraguayan shares, the art. 79 exemptions, IDU at 15% on dividends and branch profits paid abroad, monthly Forms 525 and 526, and the six double tax treaties in force with their dividend, interest and royalty caps. Trigger on: INR Paraguay, impuesto a la renta de no residentes, retención a no residentes, pagos al exterior, remesas al exterior, IDU no resid
